reproducibility.limitations: Requires licensed private resources/GZF and x86_64 x87 service. Explicit original-instruction emulation, standard/peripheral services, two FISTP sites and one FCOS site delegated. Drive/camera/pause/clock and authentic-data starting pose controlled; no WinMain/FSM, complete cockpit/weapon initialization, positive special 00440740 record, object/intersection collision or full hardware numeric parity. Inherited optional-geometry null read/unused stack warnings retained. Raw private traces/Ghidra/PE/assets not published.
